newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Malaysia's holidaying Mahathir just an e-mail away.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's holidaying Mahathir just an e-mail away.

text.p: Malaysia's acting prime minister said on Tuesday his vacationing boss Mahathir Mohamad was just an e-mail away, and that he would continue to consult him on major issues.

Ibrahim Anwar this week took over the running of the government while Mahathir goes on his break, offically a holiday mixed with business but which has sparked speculation over the 71-year old leader's health.

"On major issues, I still think I should consult him...but I wouldn't want to bother him with details because he has given me full trust and confidence," Anwar told reporters in Manila where he was attending a conference.
"I want him to rest. I want him to concentrate on other things, I want him to think and read and write and then come back and re-energised."
Mahathir, who has never before named an acting prime minister during his 16 years in power, will spend his most of his time in Europe.
"There are modern, sophisticated systems. We are not talking about the emperor of China (who), when he left China to go somewhere, there was no communication possible.
"Here there is e-mail, fax, telephone," Anwar said.
Anwar said he had found it extremely embarassing when asked whether the holiday was a cover for Mahathir's failing health.
"I'd know if he was ill or not...there's no reason why this issue should crop up."
